_comment: Lower-capacity ConvFSENet: 128/256 channels vs the 192/384 deploy backbone (same recipe otherwise). Recovered from the published checkpoint at https://huggingface.co/claroche1/convfsenet (subfolder 128-256/), which had no config checked into this repo. Carried over to the MP-SENet loss like every other config: the `loss` block is the shared objective and gan.disc_compress_factor is gone (the discriminator now sees the same compressed magnitude the loss uses, per upstream).
